business_problem: With up to a million parcels moving through its 13 sorting centers daily, Swiss Post requires a robust system to manage sorting, billing, and delivery while maintaining efficiency, reducing errors, and supporting rapid software updates.
solution_summary: With up to a million parcels moving through its 13 sorting centers daily, Swiss Post requires a robust system to manage sorting, billing, and delivery while maintaining efficiency, reducing errors, and supporting rapid software updates. Swiss Post adopted MongoDB Atlas to modernize its logistics software, enabling fast lookups, seamless parcel sorting, and automated data management across its sorting centers.
